name: IEEE 123 Node Test Feeder
description: IEEE 123 Node Test Feeder (IEEE PES Distribution System Analysis Subcommittee; data and published power-flow results in docs/reference/models/S289-feeder123.zip: line, configuration, spot load, capacitor, switch and regulator data, and 'IEEE 123 Node Test Feeder Letterhead.doc'). Line codes are the document's configurations 1-12 (Z ohm/mile and B uS/mile as printed, 4 decimals). Source node 150 at 1.0 pu, 4.16 kV; the substation transformer is not modelled (the published results start at node 150 = 1.0000 pu). Regulators RG1-RG4 are ideal step regulators on the taps the published results report (7/7/7, -1, 0/-1, 8/1/5; 0.625 % per step) at the node named in the regulator data, each with its own output node (ids 9001-9004, named RG1-RG4 as in the published voltage profile). Closed switches have no impedance (the data gives none). Open switches 54-94 and 151-300 are listed open; 250-251, 450-451 and 300-350 tie to nodes outside this feeder and are omitted. Transformer XFM-1 and node 610 are omitted: they serve no load, so they carry no current and change no other voltage. Spot load at node 4 is given as 'Y-PR' in the spreadsheet, read as Y-PQ (the published results list it as a wye constant-power load, 40 kW + 20 kvar).
